description: Send your agent's running sandbox sessions (up to 200; call it on a heartbeat, e.g. every 5 minutes) and get back which are idle past your threshold or over their max lifetime, the dollars idle time has cost at the hourly rates you pass, and what to do. Pro acts: returns a ready-to-run kill call per idle sandbox for its provider (E2B kill, Vercel Sandbox stop, Daytona stop, Modal terminate) and POSTs one alert per sandbox to your webhook. Free watch-only returns would_kill and sends nothing. We never hold provider keys and never kill anything ourselves: your agent runs the call with its own key.

alert_webhook.description: https URL Pro posts the idle alert (with the kill call) to.

fleet.description: A stable name for this group of sandboxes, e.g. "my-agent". State and rules are kept per fleet.

idle_minutes.description: Idle minutes before a sandbox counts as idle. Default 15 (or your saved Pro rule).

max_lifetime_minutes.description: Optional: flag sandboxes running longer than this, idle or not.

rates_per_hour.description: Optional default USD per hour by provider, e.g. {"e2b": 0.17}. Your own numbers; per-session rate_per_hour wins.

age_minutes.description: Minutes since it started (or pass started_at). Used for max lifetime.

id.description: Sandbox id as your provider returns it (E2B sandboxId, Vercel sandbox name, Daytona id or name, Modal object_id).

idle_minutes.description: Minutes since the sandbox last did work (a command, a request). Or pass last_activity_at.

last_activity_at.description: ISO time of the last work in the sandbox (instead of idle_minutes).

provider.description: e2b, vercel, daytona, modal, or any other name.

rate_per_hour.description: What this sandbox costs you per hour in USD, from your provider's price page or bill. Optional; without it we count minutes, not dollars.

session_id.description: Vercel only: the current session id, used in the REST stop call.

status.description: running (default), paused or stopped. Paused and stopped sessions are skipped.

name: track_sessions
